info.title: parsBackUp fixture API
info.description: P03 fixture interface. See p01-api-contract.md for actor/intent and containment invariants. A supervised listener admits jobs. The read-only listener returns CONTAINMENT_UNAVAILABLE for job mutations.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-backupctl
sessionCookie.description: Exclusive with bearer; cookie mutations require exact Origin + X-CSRF-Token. Local HTTP fixture development uses backupctl-dev instead.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Actor/method/route-scoped UUIDv4. Submission retries return the original job. Cancellation retries return the current state of the referenced job.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Required for cookie-authenticated mutations; bearer authentication is exclusive.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exact configured origin required for login and cookie mutations; reject a mismatched supplied origin on any call.

After.name: after
After.description: Exclusive UUID ascending keyset cursor; observational pagination.

LoginOrigin.name: Origin
LoginOrigin.description: Exact configured origin required for login and cookie mutations; reject a mismatched supplied origin on any call.

409.description: Idempotency, state, config or confirmation conflict

429.description: Rate or queue limit; no admission

503.description: Service, containment, discovery or capacity unavailable

verification_level.description: The signed artifact retains its recorded verification level. The completed restore is represented by the job state.
